issues.problem: The pale gray plus glyph in the “Add” control falls below the 3:1 contrast required for an actionable icon.
issues.edit: Darken the plus glyph to achieve at least 3:1 contrast against its button surface.

issues.problem: The device’s connection status is conveyed only by a green dot, with no text or distinct icon identifying its meaning.
issues.edit: Replace the plain status dot with a recognizable connected-status icon or add a visible “Connected” label.
